files.purpose_and_callers: Password policy, HIBP range check and reuse guard. ResetPassword/ChangePassword call compromise check; ChangePassword calls history check.
files.trust_state_errors_concurrency: Configurable strength limits, SHA-1 prefix sent to remote API, suffix checked locally. Remote error returns not-compromised. Repository/hasher error returns different-from-history. Both broad catches also absorb cancellation. History limit uses config in place of method argument.
files.test_evidence: PasswordValidatorTests.cs:64–143 establishes fail-open and matching using mocks. No external HIBP/DB calls or cancellation scenario executed.
files.conclusion: Record fail-open policy and cancellation as review boundaries.

files.purpose_and_callers: ITokenService issues access and refresh tokens and parses signed access claims.
files.trust_state_errors_concurrency: Signed HMAC access claims include subject, JTI, PII and roles. Refresh generation uses 64 random bytes. Normal validation checks lifetime; separate principal extraction allows expired tokens but validates issuer, audience and signature. No public production caller found for expired extraction.
files.test_evidence: TokenServiceTests.cs:16–83 covers generated/invalid/expired/wrong-issuer cases by source. Existing session races BE-003/004 depend on handlers/repositories.
files.conclusion: Cryptographic issuance and durable session state have separate boundaries.

files.purpose_and_callers: 2FA secret/QR production and TOTP verification used by Auth setup/login flows.
files.trust_state_errors_concurrency: Random key, ±2 step validation, per-user/step Redis SET NX and TTL. Redis error denies. Accepted-code Redis side effect can outlive caller cancellation because token is unused by the method. No Redis values were accessed.
files.test_evidence: AuthSupportServicesTests.cs:158–191 uses a mock. Redis replay/concurrent requests and cancellation not reproduced.
files.conclusion: Single-step atomic replay gate visible in source.

files.purpose_and_callers: IAuditService adapter stores security audit event and severity in AuthDbContext.
files.trust_state_errors_concurrency: Adds tracked audit record and saves with token; logs all failures and returns. Shared context can persist other tracked changes during this call. No application callsite found beyond interface and implementation by symbol search.
files.test_evidence: AuthAuditAndBlacklistServiceTests.cs:19–56 checks successful and swallowed failures. Provider effects untested.
files.conclusion: Adapter is best-effort in the observed contract.

files.purpose_and_callers: IAvatarMetrics bridges UploadAvatarCommandHandler to shared PlanoraMetrics.
files.trust_state_errors_concurrency: Records outcome and variant-size tags. Caller chooses finite outcome values. Handler emits success before profile save. No I/O or user-specific tag at this boundary.
files.test_evidence: UploadAvatarCommandHandler.cs:66–96 traced; exporter and failure telemetry unverified.
files.conclusion: Success metric measures processing/storage stage, before profile commit.

files.purpose_and_callers: Scoped ICurrentUserService reads HttpContext principal and request metadata for Auth handlers.
files.trust_state_errors_concurrency: NameIdentifier must parse as Guid. Auth flag separate. Remote address and User-Agent are context metadata. Roles permits repeats, Claims dictionary throws for repeated type. No external Claims getter callsite found in Auth by scoped search.
files.test_evidence: DependencyInjection.cs:140 and UploadAvatarCommandHandler.cs:49–51 traced; multi-role Claims getter not exercised.
files.conclusion: Identity trust comes from authenticated principal supplied by middleware.

files.purpose_and_callers: IDateTime adapter registered in Auth DI.
files.trust_state_errors_concurrency: Returns current UTC from system clock. Stateless, no cancellation/I/O.
files.test_evidence: DependencyInjection.cs:141 traced; no wall-clock or timing experiment.
files.conclusion: Simple clock boundary.

files.purpose_and_callers: Content-addressed avatar variants written by UploadAvatarCommandHandler, tree removed in retention/deletion paths.
files.trust_state_errors_concurrency: Writes live path with FileMode.Create, verifies lexical containment, then prunes other hashes. Put cancellation can interrupt a multi-file write. Prune precedes DB profile save, with no atomic link between filesystem and DB. No per-user lock.
files.test_evidence: LocalAvatarStorageTests.cs:22–95 verifies layout, sequential prune, delete and empty owner. Handler save failure and concurrent upload absent from reviewed evidence.
files.conclusion: Filesystem/database ordering yields a static integrity defect.

files.purpose_and_callers: Generic local file storage DI adapter with no application save/delete callsites found by direct symbol search.
files.trust_state_errors_concurrency: Normalizes one folder segment, sanitizes base and adds GUID unless already suffixed. Extension taken from name. Containment is lexical and case-insensitive. Uses direct writes with token, cancellation may leave incomplete file. Delete synchronously removes existing file.
files.test_evidence: Scoped search finds only interface/implementation for these methods. No active upload reachability or symlink test claimed.
files.conclusion: Current avatar upload uses IAvatarStorage.

files.purpose_and_callers: UploadAvatar image processor validates bytes, then generates small/medium/large WebP.
files.trust_state_errors_concurrency: Bounds actual reads and dimensions before bitmap allocation. Signature and codec checks. Re-encode from fresh pixels and derive SHA-256 hash prefix. Cancellation checked at read/decode/variant boundaries. Each request owns buffers.
files.test_evidence: AvatarDecodeBoundaryTests covers actual length, dimensions, truncation, cancellation, crop and EXIF stripping by source. Native decode not run.
files.conclusion: Bounds verified in source and existing test cases.

files.purpose_and_callers: Message record for EmailService to IEmailMessageSender.
files.trust_state_errors_concurrency: Carries recipient PII and potentially action credential in HTML/text. Record has no delivery policy. Default record formatting would expose data if caller logged the full value; reviewed log calls log subject/provider.
files.test_evidence: AuthSupportServicesTests captures synthetic message. No SMTP or mail logging experiment.
files.conclusion: Keep message contents in sender boundary.

files.purpose_and_callers: Email section options, SMTP/log mode detection and effective From fallback.
files.trust_state_errors_concurrency: Default Log, SMTP defaults include TLS. Credentials only via configured fields. Invalid config checked at send. Mutable options captured by EmailService. No runtime config read.
files.test_evidence: AuthSupportServicesTests.cs:55–131 covers test provider selection and missing credential.
files.conclusion: Configuration source and production overrides unverified.

files.purpose_and_callers: Builds Auth verification/reset/change/lock/2FA notifications and delegates to SMTP or Log sink.
files.trust_state_errors_concurrency: Encodes HTML recipient name/body/links, trust of link scheme assigned to producers. Log mode emits fixed subject only. Sender cancellation passed; SMTP exceptions propagate to caller. Side-effect retry/idempotency outside adapter.
files.test_evidence: AuthSupportServicesTests.cs:30–131 covers log sink, mock SMTP and invalid config; no mailbox/network test.
files.conclusion: Secret-bearing links not written by reviewed service log calls.

files.purpose_and_callers: Sender seam between email construction and SMTP transport.
files.trust_state_errors_concurrency: Explicit token and full EmailMessage/EmailOptions. Interface provides no durable queue, retry, or acknowledgement beyond returned Task.
files.test_evidence: Mock sender in AuthSupportServicesTests.cs:294 onward, no provider execution.
files.conclusion: Implementations own cancellation and transport guarantees.

files.purpose_and_callers: Auth hosted service obtains/rechecks broker connection immediately and on a periodic timer.
files.trust_state_errors_concurrency: Calls connection manager with stopping token. Broad probe catch logs and continues; loop awaits serially, finally disposes timer. Connection ownership belongs to manager. This does not register the consumer binding itself.
files.test_evidence: RabbitMqStartupHostedServiceTests.cs:16–124 covers mocked connection states, exception, tick, and cancelled stop. No broker exercised.
files.conclusion: Startup probing distinct from T05 topology.

files.purpose_and_callers: SMTP sender builds MailMessage/alternate MIME views and per-call SmtpClient.
files.trust_state_errors_concurrency: Credentials and TLS determined by configured options. Mail and client disposed. Passes caller token to send. Delivery latency and effective async timeout not tested.
files.test_evidence: Mock sender tests validate EmailService wiring. SMTP protocol not executed.
files.conclusion: Async delivery guarantee depends on transport.

files.purpose_and_callers: Generates ten random recovery codes, hashes for storage, validates and consumes during Auth flow.
files.trust_state_errors_concurrency: Repository operations receive token. Original snapshot enumerates unused codes, verifies then marks and saves. No atomic compare-and-set in reviewed service. Plaintext returned once by method for display.
files.test_evidence: BE-011 already records concurrent redemption. Root work in other files is excluded from this finding status.
files.conclusion: Existing BE-011, no new duplicate finding.

files.purpose_and_callers: Auth token blacklist IDistributedCache adapter read by global TokenBlacklistFilter.
files.trust_state_errors_concurrency: TTL based on expiry. Redis key includes raw input token. Write failures rethrow. Read failures, including cancellation, return false, so filter continues to security-stamp logic. No live producer found for blacklist writes in current source search.
files.test_evidence: AuthAuditAndBlacklistServiceTests.cs:58–96 covers TTL/write error and asserts false on read error despite test name. TokenBlacklistFilter.cs:24–57 inspected.
files.conclusion: Source behavior recorded. Production revoke effectiveness remains unverified.

files.purpose_and_callers: Category Docker image builds from repo-root context and publishes API for Linux.
files.trust_state_errors_concurrency: Separate REST/gRPC exposed ports, non-root app user, HTTP health probe on 80. Package/image retrieval and listener wiring are environment-dependent.
files.test_evidence: Dockerfile compared to appsettings.Docker.json and Program health mapping. No image built.
files.conclusion: Configured ports align in these files.

files.purpose_and_callers: Category API compile-time imports for validators, mediator, JWT, MVC, tracing, Serilog and JSON.
files.trust_state_errors_concurrency: No auth/policy/connection setup via imports. Runtime pipeline defined in Program.
files.test_evidence: Program.cs:40–98,167–209 traced; no compilation in batch.
files.conclusion: Imports describe compilation scope.

files.purpose_and_callers: Category Web project references GrpcContracts, shared BuildingBlocks and service layers.
files.trust_state_errors_concurrency: net10.0 Linux project, design package private assets, UserSecretsId names a store. No secret store access or restore.
files.test_evidence: Static dependency read and Dockerfile COPY comparison.
files.conclusion: Project boundaries recorded.

files.purpose_and_callers: Category startup wires DB/Redis/transport, JWT, CORS, service-key gRPC, controllers and health routes.
files.trust_state_errors_concurrency: Startup waits for dependencies, validates schema with retry, subscribes to user deletion, then runs host. DB create target literal differs from configured connection target. Cancellation forwarded to wait/schema/subscribe; Redis ConnectAsync call itself has no token. User-keyed rate limiting follows auth.
files.test_evidence: DependencyWaiter.cs:23–53,63–101 and shared DI 42–43,88–89 checked. CategoryDatabaseStartup checked via callsite only; no host launch.
files.conclusion: Static database target mismatch.

files.purpose_and_callers: Launch profiles for Development/Staging/Production and local environment variables.
files.trust_state_errors_concurrency: Profiles declare URL and config keys. Kestrel endpoint sections and env providers determine effective listeners and values. Credential-like literals masked. Local profile configuration not used as proof of deployment.
files.test_evidence: Compared names to Program and RabbitMqConnectionManager.cs:33. No profile launched.
files.conclusion: OPS-003/010 are separate scanner evidence.

files.purpose_and_callers: Docker-specific Category logging/DB/broker/JWT/listener settings.
files.trust_state_errors_concurrency: REST HTTP/1 on 80, gRPC HTTP/2 on 81, blank JWT/broker credential placeholders and configuration overrides. Sensitive values masked.
files.test_evidence: Dockerfile and Program matched by source. No compose substitution or runtime configuration read.
files.conclusion: Effective deploy settings outside scope.

files.purpose_and_callers: Base Category logging, CORS, connection/cache defaults, JWT and Kestrel settings.
files.trust_state_errors_concurrency: REST 5281, gRPC 5282, explicit local CORS, blank JWT and broker credential placeholders. Redis:Configuration vs startup connection-string fallback are separate paths. Sensitive values masked.
files.test_evidence: Program.cs:61–80,110–125 and shared DI 42–43,88–89 compared. No active settings loaded.
files.conclusion: Source defaults only.

new_findings.title: Загрузка аватара удаляет прежнюю ревизию до сохранения нового URL
new_findings.trigger: У пользователя сохранён URL прежней ревизии. Новый PutAsync успешно завершает prune, затем запись профиля отклонена или отменена до commit.
new_findings.impact: В БД остаётся прежний URL, файлы прежней ревизии уже удалены. Конкурентные загрузки тоже не синхронизируют порядок prune и commit.
new_findings.repro: Сохранить аватар A, вызвать загрузку B с инъекцией ошибки SaveChangesAsync после PutAsync, проверить сохранённый URL и существование файлов A. Конкурентный вариант требует отдельного теста.
new_findings.fix: Привязать очистку к фактически подтверждённой ревизии профиля и сериализовать очистку с обновлениями этого владельца.

new_findings.title: Category startup создаёт БД с фиксированным именем вместо настроенной
new_findings.trigger: В ConnectionStrings:CategoryDatabase указана отсутствующая БД с отличающимся именем и запускается обычный startup.
new_findings.impact: Startup сначала проверяет или создаёт planora_category. Затем соединяется с исходной настроенной БД, которую первый шаг не создал. При отсутствии прав возможен отказ на попытке создать постороннее имя.
new_findings.repro: В разрешённом отдельном PostgreSQL fixture задать уникальную отсутствующую CategoryDatabase, запустить обычный startup и проверить фактический create target и исход соединения.
new_findings.fix: Извлечь имя из той же строки соединения, проверить его до startup waiter и передать точное имя.

limits: Охват включает только 25 manifest paths. Supplemental caller/test traces в счётчик не входят.
Чтение относится к указанному HEAD. SHA-256 вычислены по байтам рабочего дерева, diff по scope к HEAD пуст.
В конфигурационных файлах чувствительные значения скрыты. Активные env-файлы, secret stores и auth/credentials не загружались.
Build, unit/provider tests, Auth/Category hosts, Docker, PostgreSQL, Redis, SMTP и HIBP не запускались.
Новые находки предварительные. BE-003, BE-004, BE-011, OPS-003, OPS-007 и OPS-010 уже ведутся отдельно.
